title: Alien reproduction vehicles exist and are stored at known sites

tellings.quote: Well, I mean, I can just say that they exist. Okay. And I know where some of them are stored at, but that's about it.

plain: Alien reproduction vehicles, human-built copies of alien craft, really exist, says Michael Herrera, who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle. He tells Michels he knows where some of them are stored, but he will not say more than that.
